correctness.rationale: Exact multinomial one-box and ordered two-box probabilities give E[N_r], E[N_s], E[N_rN_s] and normalized cross moment T_n. Algebraic cancellation yields T_(n+1)/T_n=m(m−2)/(m−1)²·[1+rs/((n+1)(n+1−r−s))], which strictly decreases for n≥r+s, m≥3, r≠s≥1. Hence T_n is positive strictly log-concave and tends to zero, so {n:T_n>1} is a single finite interval, exactly the positive-covariance indices. Exact rational checks confirm signs at (m,r,s;n)=(10,1,8;9,20,70) are −,+,−. Expanding log T_n at n/m→λ yields m(T_n−1)→r+s−1−λ−rs/λ, and E N_j/m→e^(−λ)λ^j/j!, giving asserted limiting covariance sign diagram. Independent exact multinomial enumeration/ratio tests passed; finite checks do not prove all parameters.
residual_risks: Fixed m≥3, distinct positive r,s for finite theorem; no unequal probabilities or r=s claim.
At limiting quadratic roots first-order limit vanishes and cannot fix finite-n sign.
